baseline_content.desktop:forces: LLOYDS BANKING GROUP PLC · RATES AND EARNINGS What can put pressure on earnings? Observed condition UK monetary policy · industry context Reported: The November policy decision raises Bank Rate to 4%. Meeting ending 4 November 2026 Transmission Funding costs reprice first If funding costs rise faster than asset yields, spread can narrow. Lending reprices first If asset yields rise faster, spread can widen. Disclosed response No eligible evidence links a Lloyds response to this rate decision. Separate Group efficiency ambition Reported: Management target The 2030 efficiency ambition is a cost-to-income ratio below 45%. Strategy for 2027–2030 Conditional consequence Conditional · A weaker spread can reduce income. The cost-to-income ratio can rise even when operating costs are steady. Earnings sensitivity depends on the timing and size of repricing. To assess Lloyds’ exposure, compare deposit and asset repricing, income and costs over matching periods.
